mapper.insert: insert into jsh_project_category (name, category_level, parent_id, sort, serial_no, remark, create_time, update_time, tenant_id, delete_flag) values (#{name}, #{categoryLevel}, #{parentId}, #{sort}, #{serialNo}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{tenantId}, '0')
mapper.update: update jsh_project_category set name = #{name}, category_level = #{categoryLevel}, parent_id = #{parentId}, sort = #{sort}, serial_no = #{serialNo}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ifnull(delete_flag,'0') !='1'
mapper.select: select * from jsh_project_category where parent_id = #{parentId} and ifnull(delete_flag,'0') !='1' order by sort asc
